question: This is my first postcard. On the third panel of p. 107 in Volume 49, Chapter 475, there are guys saying they're the Risky Brothers! Also, the zombie who tried to take Nami's group to Moria (V.47, C.451) was one of the Risky Brothers, too, wasn't he?
answer: Yes, that's right. Those cute lil' squirrels were being moved by the shadows of some crusty, greasy men.
name: Yoshiki
